title: Read research like an engineer
outcome: Write two structured paper notes and design a small reproduction.

blocks.body: Question: Which claims survive a closer look?
Mathematics: Connect assumptions, objective functions, experimental controls, effect sizes, and uncertainty to research claims.
Dataset: Reuse the frozen soccer datasets and splits. For reproduction, use the selected paper’s public data if feasible; otherwise label the soccer experiment as an adaptation.
Reading: Use abstracts to choose questions, then inspect methods and limitations. Refresh the current article when this stage begins.
